Section 2 rule 2 writes no node fuel names or zero rows on the host: none of the four capture variants carries blast-furnace, coke-oven or by-product gas rows now.

Left on their own basis: IEA 2013 Annex 4 Table 5 cracker rows (energy allocated by mass over all products, so its "ethylene from ethane/gas oil" values are effectively per t of cracker product; gas oil at 12.0 GJ/t below ethane at 16.0 GJ/t confirms it), Saygin 2011 Tables 1-2 (per t output = HVC; its BPT 13.1 heat less 1.4 steam matches the 12 GJ/t HVC BPT), Agora, IEA 2018, Bataille, Ren 2009 and UKERC (all per t HVC).
